root_cause_statement: Not a code/sign/unit defect: the benchmark interpolates the publisher's own signed CT/J columns without any unit or axis conversion, so conventions cannot alter the sign. The 6018 RPM sweep crosses zero thrust at J~0.6705; the RPM-blended calibration interpolator places the crossing at J~0.6721 (delta-J ~0.0017, 0.25%), interpolating between planes measured at 4005 and 6708.5 RPM. At J=0.671 - one table count below the model crossing - the model predicts +0.000218 CT (~+1.4 gf assumed density) and the measurement records -0.0001 (exactly -1 count of the 4-decimal format, ~-0.5 gf): both are zero within the source's resolution. The disagreement is a small-|CT| straddle of CT=0, not a sign error.
repair_spec_for_p0a_009: Classify sign disagreements with resolution awareness: a disagreement where |measured CT| <= 1 table count AND |predicted CT| <= 10 counts is reported as sign_disagreements_resolution_limited, not as a hard disagreement.
Record per-row predicted values in the results artifact so future audits do not re-derive them.
Predeclare the sign-resolution rule and uncertainty band before scoring (M24 acceptance uses only the supported envelope; extrapolation outside it is refused or labeled).
